items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I went on, I played with Cindy Delivine for two years.

ctx.x: Well, I, I knew a little about the work already, see, so I went right on up there, went to work. And I did all this, the linen clothes, you know, shirts and all the linen clothes. And I stood up there and worked good well. And I, I, I even turned down jobs. You stayed there? I mean, uh, uh, uh, working places where, they wanted me to work over there regularly. On, uh, Iperville Street when they had that little nightclub, and I wouldn't go over there. I said, well, I'm doing all right where I'm at. You see? I…
